note: The Node that ships inside the Windows app. 24 is what the runner is tested on (engines >=24) and the Windows CI job uses. Checksums are from https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.2/SHASUMS256.txt. To move to another Node: change the version, replace both hashes from that release's SHASUMS256.txt, and run installer/fetch-node.ps1 for each architecture.
